title: Ghost Grid and Echo Frame ancient deterioration canon
summary: Ghost Grid constructs are ancient advanced machines with accumulated age, heavy wear, overgrowth, and mechanical faults. Echo Frames are distinct old Ghost Grid-era sentient Frames, often humanoid or hulking with layered armor, exposed systems, torn fabric, and individualized silhouettes. They are weathered and overgrown too, with conspicuous glitches, memory/display instability, actuator failures, and unpredictable motion. Character reference sheets for Fract, Relay, Ruin, Murmur, and Bastion guide appearance. Broken details must be intentional and readable, not shortcuts for poor sprite anatomy.
source: Founder-approved Bearframe RPG reference images and art-direction corrections, Nov 2026
